banner.title: NS Commissions app
banner.bodyAndroid: Your commission on your phone — faster and always signed in.
banner.bodyIos: Install it on your iPhone from Safari — icon, full screen and notifications.
banner.bodyInstalled: You have the app — open this page in it.

page.title: NS Commissions
page.lead: Your sales, collections and commission in your pocket. Open it in a second, stay signed in, and get notified the moment your commission rates change.
page.version: Android version {version} · {size} MB · Android 7 or newer
page.noteAndroid: Your phone is ready — tap Android to download.
page.noteIos: On iPhone: Safari → Share → Add to Home Screen (steps below).
page.noteDesktop: Open this page on your Android phone to download the app.
page.f1Body: Today's commission, target progress and bonuses the moment you open it.
page.f2Body: Every invoice, customer and day — the same live numbers as the website.
page.f3Body: Know right away when commission rates or rules change.
page.f4Body: Your own account, your own data only, and no signing in every time.
page.s1: Tap “Download for Android” on your phone.
page.s2: Open the downloaded file (from the notification or the Downloads folder).
page.s3: If Android asks, allow installing apps from this source, then tap Install.
page.s4: Open NS Commissions and sign in with your usual username and password.
page.androidNote: New versions install over the old one — your sign-in is kept.
page.iosBody: A native iPhone app is not available yet. Until it is, you can add NS Commissions to your Home Screen and use the website like an app.
page.iosMeanwhile: Temporary alternative: install the web app from Safari. Its icon opens NS Commissions directly in its own app-like screen.
page.i1: Open this site in Safari on your iPhone, then tap the Share button.
page.i2: Choose “Add to Home Screen”, then Add.
page.alreadyInstalled: Already have the app? Open it
page.i3: Tap the NS Commissions icon on your Home Screen, sign in, then go to My account to enable notifications.
